commit.message: add gpu resource request support and update tests

issues.title: [ml] add gpu resource request support and update test
issues.body:
* adds gpu resource request limit to KubernetesPodOperator
* adds test for new parameter

issues.title: Remove unused, broken argument
issues.body:
We specify host aliases via the `KubernetesPodOperator`, they aren't a configuration input to airflow workers.

`Pod` has a default arg for `host_aliases` (the empty list), so not specifying it is safe.
